title: Feelings
examples: What does it feel like when I am very happy?
If I am angry, what should I do?
Can you show me what scared looks like?

explain.say: Today you will learn about feelings. Feelings are how you feel inside. All feelings are okay.
When you feel happy, you might smile or laugh.
When you feel sad, your face might look down. You might want a hug.

draw.text: Sad: face looks down, may want a hug

explain.say: When you feel angry, your body might feel hot. Your hands might make fists.
When you feel scared, your tummy might feel funny. You might want a grown-up close by.

draw.text: Scared: funny tummy, want a grown-up near

explain.say: If your friend is crying, you can name the feeling. You can say, you seem sad.

draw.text: Naming feelings: Name what you see

faq.q: How do I know if I am feeling angry?
faq.a: You might feel hot or want to stomp your feet. You can also feel tense in your body.
asks: How do I know I am mad?

faq.q: What should I do when I feel scared?
faq.a: It is okay to feel scared. Take three slow, deep breaths. Tell a grown-up you trust.
asks: How do I calm down from fear?
What helps when I am scared?

faq.q: Can I feel two feelings at once?
faq.a: Yes, you can. You might feel happy but also a little bit sad. That is okay.
asks: Can I be sad and happy?

faq.q: Why is it important to name my feelings?
faq.a: Naming your feelings helps you understand them better. It helps grown-ups help you too.
asks: Why say my feelings out loud?

faq.q: What is the best way to calm down?
faq.a: Taking slow, deep breaths is a good way to calm down. You can also count to ten slowly.
asks: How do I calm down when angry?

facts: It is normal to feel all different feelings.
Deep breaths help calm big feelings down.
A smile can help you feel happy.
It is okay to tell someone how you feel.

quiz.say: Kofi loses his favourite toy. How might Kofi feel?
quiz.why: Losing something you love often makes you feel sad. Feeling sad is okay.

wrong.0: Happy fits good news, like finding the toy again.
wrong.2: Excited fits something fun, like a party.

quiz.say: Amira feels very angry. What can help her calm down?
quiz.show: 😠 What can help Amira calm down?
quiz.why: Slow breaths help your body calm down. Feeling angry is okay.

wrong.1: Yelling at a friend can upset them, even when you feel angry.
wrong.2: Throwing a toy can break it or hurt someone.

quiz.say: Sam gets a hug from Grandad. How might Sam feel?
quiz.show: 🤗 Sam gets a hug from Grandad.
quiz.why: A hug from someone you love often makes you feel happy.

wrong.0: Angry fits when something feels unfair.
wrong.1: Scared fits when something feels unsafe.
